ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_advantage_margin_relusum
ir.intuition: Repaired to avoid logsigmoid similarity by replacing logsigmoid with a ReLU margin-based loss. This computes the margin as advantage_w - advantage_l and applies ReLU to ensure non-negativity on (margin - diff_log_prob) encouraging the model to push log_prob_w above log_prob_l by at least the margin weighted by advantage. This yields a distinct hinge-style pairwise loss emphasizing margin ranking with advantage weighting and ensures no logsigmoid or neg usage, improving novelty and preserving preference signal.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = advantage_w - advantage_l
log_prob_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
loss = relu(margin - log_prob_diff) * weight
final_loss = mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    advantage_w = batch['advantage_w']
    advantage_l = batch['advantage_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)

    margin = ops.sub(advantage_w, advantage_l)
    log_prob_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)

    loss_per_pair = ops.relu(ops.sub(margin, log_prob_diff))

    if weight is not None:
        loss_per_pair = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)

    return ops.mean(loss_per_pair)
